title: Your Test Results
about: A letter to the patient with test results and what to do next, signed by the clinician.

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: Here are the results of your recent tests.

blocks.label: What to do next
items: Your results are normal. You do not need to do anything more about them.
Your results need follow-up. Please call us to make a visit. If we do not hear from you by the date below, we will call you.
Please repeat the test on or after the date below.
Keep taking your medicines as you do now.
We changed a medicine. See the notes below.

blocks.text: If you have questions, please call us at {facility.phone}.
